title: qRT-PCR for Zebrafish Brain Tissue
author: Robin Zhang
materials: Reagents: RNA Extraction Kit (QIAGEN, 74034), RT-PCR Kit (Thermo, Ref 4374966), qPCR Kit(Promega, USA, A6002)
Equipments: Centrifuge, Nanodrop, Thermocycler, qPCR Machine and consumables
Export Ct values and perform quality control

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Workspace
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary buffers and ensure a sterile environment for RNA work.

substeps.instruction: Supplement Buffer RLT Plus with β-mercaptoethanol by adding 10 µL β-mercaptoethanol per 1 mL Buffer RLT Plus.
Use RNase-free tubes, tips, and reagents throughout the procedure.
Keep all samples and RNA-containing solutions on ice where possible.

steps.title: Collect and Prepare Tissue
steps.instruction: Dissect and process the zebrafish larval brain tissue.

substeps.instruction: Dissect zebrafish larval brain tissue.
Immediately freeze the tissue on dry ice if extraction is not performed immediately.

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Disrupt the tissue to create a homogeneous lysate.

substeps.instruction: If the homogenised lysate has been frozen, thaw the sample thoroughly using a water bath or metal bath for approximately 1 min 30 s.
Homogenise the tissue thoroughly using a 20-gauge needle and an RNase-free syringe, passing the lysate through the needle multiple times until fully disrupted and homogeneous.
Add 350 µL Buffer RLT Plus supplemented with β-mercaptoethanol to each sample.

steps.title: Remove Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Clear the lysate of genomic DNA using a gDNA Eliminator spin column.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate for 3 min at full speed to pellet debris.
Carefully transfer the cleared supernatant to a gDNA Eliminator spin column placed in a collection tube, avoiding any pellet material.
Centrifuge for 30 s at 12,000 rpm.
Keep the flow-through and discard the gDNA Eliminator spin column.

steps.title: Bind and Wash RNA
steps.instruction: Bind the RNA to the RNeasy MinElute column and perform washes.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 µL 70% ethanol to the flow-through and mix well by pipetting (do not centrifuge at this stage).
Transfer the ethanol-containing mixture to an RNeasy MinElute spin column placed in a collection tube.
Centrifuge for 15 s at 12,000 rpm and discard the flow-through.
Add 500 µL 80% ethanol to the column.
Centrifuge for 15 s at 12,000 rpm and discard the flow-through.
Add 500 µL Buffer RPE to the column.
Centrifuge for 15 s at 12,000 rpm and discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Dry and Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Dry the column membrane and recover the purified RNA.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the column for 5–6 min at full speed to dry the membrane completely.
Place the RNeasy MinElute column into a new RNase-free 1.5 mL collection tube.
Add 14 µL RNase-free water directly to the centre of the membrane.
Centrifuge to elute RNA.
Record the final RNA concentration and purity after elution.

steps.title: Store Purified RNA
steps.instruction: Store the RNA based on the intended timeframe for use.

substeps.instruction: Store purified RNA on ice for immediate reverse transcription, or at −80°C for longer-term storage.

steps.title: Prepare cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Synthesize cDNA following the kit instructions while maintaining cold temperatures.

substeps.instruction: Follow the kit system suggestions, keeping the whole process on ICE.
Use the sample with the lowest concentration to determine the total amount of RNA as input.

steps.title: Set Up qPCR Reaction
steps.instruction: Plan and prepare the qPCR plate for gene expression analysis.

substeps.instruction: Plan a plate layout in Excel or qPCR software; each biological sample should be analyzed with both target gene and housekeeping gene primers.
Use technical triplicates for each sample-primer combination (e.g., Replica 1, 2, 3 and NTC).
Prepare the qPCR reaction mix.
Do not test the concentration of the RT-PCR product; proceed straight to qPCR.

steps.title: Run qPCR and Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Execute the qPCR run and perform relative expression calculations.

substeps.instruction: Load and run the qPCR plate following the kit protocol.
Calculate ΔCt values.
Calculate ΔΔCt and relative expression.
Perform statistical analysis.
